verdict: MATERIAL EDIT. The previous W1-30 plan would not have produced a game that looks good. Its acceptance contract gated almost entirely on instrument validity and reference legality; its one substantive human-quality read (RI-VIS06 Protocol A) is conditioned on legal paired modern pixels the plan itself records as largely missing, so the load-bearing quality signal reduced to RI-VIS03 M1-M12 image statistics, which procedural noise raises. The shipped build then did exactly that. Plan rewritten as a parent plus ten child plans, two shared mechanism documents, and an evidence standard in which human judgement of many frames and motion sequences is primary and the statistics are a regression tripwire only.

children.name: Visual truth, the Deck, the defect inventory

code_level_findings: No MSAA on the shipping frame: renderer.js:64 sets antialias:true on the context, but the world renders into worldTarget (renderer.js:253) whose samples is never set. Context MSAA applies only to the default framebuffer.

IBL is a 16x8 = 128-texel DataTexture assigned directly as scene.environment (sky.js:185-191) with no PMREMGenerator, so there is no roughness-convolved mip chain and every material gets the same flat specular blob.
One shadow map over a 120 m box: sky.js:139-148, 2048 sq, ortho +/-60, near 40, far 210. No cascades. Nothing beyond ~60 m of focus is shadowed.
The colour grade is saturation x1.035, contrast x1.015, vignette 0.075 - effectively a no-op. No per-region or per-weather grading exists.
Bloom is 4 taps at 2 px, threshold 0.72, added at 0.075. AO is 4 depth taps at 3 px clamped to 0.12.
No dither before 8-bit output; sky and fog gradients band.

Zero authored 3D models in the repository: grep for GLTFLoader/.glb/.gltf over game/src returns nothing. Characters are 17 Sphere, 9 Capsule, 9 Cone, 6 Torus, 6 Cylinder, 3 Dodecahedron primitives skinned to a hand-built skeleton.

Three authored texture sets for the whole province (brown_mud, bark_brown_01, plastered_stone_wall) covering 9 of 20 material families; 9 more families have a single 256px albedo-only jpg with no normal and no roughness; skin and water are procedural noise only.
Foliage is not alpha-tested: visual-foundation.js:159 defaults alphaTest 0 and no consumer overrides it.

The 96x96 hash-noise detail field (visual-foundation.js:112) used as albedo, height, AO and roughness is exactly the input that raises RI-VIS03 texture statistics without raising perceived quality - the metric-gaming risk the old plan named and then shipped.

frame_level_findings.source: docs/shots/2026-08-14-visual-truth/ (VISUAL-TRUTH-AUDIT, GPU pod, 24 orbit angles + 16-step look sweep + world-hidden pass)
frame_level_findings.coverage: one location (settlement approach, noon, rain) and one subject (the player). Multi-location and multi-time sweep was still running.
findings: FogExp2(0x9aa79a, 0.0022) erases the world past ~40 m: a settlement at 40 m is a white smear with no readable silhouette. Highest-impact single change in the tree.

No directional shadow appears in any of 24 noon orbit frames despite shadowMap.enabled and sun.castShadow both true. Prime suspect: sun.shadow.camera.near = 40 clipping the scene. This is a defect, not a missing feature.

The player transparency defect is GEOMETRIC, not material. Material audit: every visible player mesh is transparent:false, opacity:1. The world-hidden capture shows sky between shoulder plate and arm, and between head and shoulders - disjoint primitives that do not weld. Every previous fix targeted the material and could not have worked.
Tree canopies render with no trunks - discs floating in the sky.
Terrain is a flat plane with a visible ~1 m quad grid and hard tile seams; no relief, no scatter.
Roads and boardwalks are flat hard-edged quads sitting on the ground with no blend, no contact darkening, visible overlap.
The shield renders as a pure black polygon; the greatsword is a flat untapered plank clipping the shield.
Rain is uniform full-intensity white lines at every depth - no distance attenuation.
An NPC renders doll-sized and floating in mid-air at wrong scale or position.
Character proportions: legs roughly twice the torso, no neck, hands are cylinders.

cross_piece_findings: Intermittent boot failure at game/src/ui/compass.js:109 - cardinalOf() indexes POINTS[NaN].label, requires non-finite camera yaw. Not reproducible by viewport size. Belongs to the HUD/UI piece, recorded here so it is not lost.

RunPod tooling needs openssh-client installed and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1, because Node's global fetch does not honour HTTPS_PROXY and every RunPod API call returns 403 Host not in allowlist while curl to the same URL returns 200. This should go into the GPU tooling docs - it costs every future agent an hour.

rulings_made.ruling: Vendoring the official same-version r180 post-processing addons (EffectComposer, RenderPass, OutputPass, SMAAPass, UnrealBloomPass, GTAOPass/SSAOPass) and the core PMREMGenerator is approved and expected, not a last resort.
rulings_made.overturned_by: a measured demonstration that the addon route cannot meet a governing predicate within budget

rulings_made.ruling: GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader and KTX2Loader are approved and required. A 7/10 look is not reachable with zero authored geometry.
rulings_made.overturned_by: W1-30D's or W1-30E's sourcing spike establishing that no legally redistributable assets of sufficient quality exist, in which case each pivots in writing to high-quality generated geometry

rulings_made.ruling: TAA is out of scope for W1-30A. MSAA + SMAA is the antialiasing route; TAA's history invalidation for cuts, teleports, resize, cell changes and animated foliage is a larger risk than the aliasing it removes.
rulings_made.overturned_by: SMAA + MSAA measurably failing the motion crawl gate

rulings_made.ruling: W1-30's children dispatch on their own plan states rather than waiting for the parent's recriticism round, because blocking the owner's top priority behind a review cycle violates rule 0 and directive 4.
rulings_made.overturned_by: a reviewer finding the decomposition's seams wrong, in which case in-flight children stop at their next commit boundary rather than merging

rulings_made.ruling: The W1-06 and W1-24 build dependencies that blocked the whole of W1-30 are dissolved. Seven of ten children have no such dependency; the two that do (D on W1-06, V on W1-24) declare it locally.
rulings_made.overturned_by: a child builder finding it genuinely cannot proceed without landed dependency work

rulings_made.ruling: RI-VIS03 M1-M12 can fail a build and can never pass one. Human judgement of many frames and motion sequences is the primary quality signal.
rulings_made.overturned_by: a demonstration that naive human judgement is not reproducible enough to gate on, in which case the fallback is fewer better-anchored judgements, not more statistics

not_done: Did not run the game. All frame evidence is the VISUAL-TRUTH-AUDIT's, captured by another agent.

The audit's multi-location and multi-time-of-day sweep was incomplete at finalisation, so severity ranking across regions is unmeasured. W1-30V has standing authority to reorder the priority list once it completes.
Saw no interior, no combat, no spell and no region other than the starting settlement approach. Claims about those rest on code reading alone.
Did not audit the other 25 plans for the same instruments-not-pictures defect, though directive 2 says to assume the failure mode is not confined to graphics. Proposed as a separate cheap piece.
Did not verify the CC0 licensing of the three authored texture sets in game/assets/w1-30/materials/; W1-30C's first gate re-checks provenance before adding more.

Did not add a concept-art / key-art child, though I flag in the parent's falsification audit that W1-30E and W1-30F may not cohere without one. I could not establish that usable key art can be generated or licensed, and inventing a blocked child is worse than naming the risk. A reviewer adding it would be right and I would not resist the edit.
next_step: Dispatch W1-30S, W1-30C (API phase) and W1-30V now; dispatch a fresh parent reviewer-editor in parallel; dispatch W1-30A, W1-30B and W1-30H the moment S lands. Each child gets one builder and one separate fresh critic per orchestration/PLAN-LOOP.md.
